sections.title: Detailed Brief Overview
rows: **World Organizations & Headquarters (विश्व संगठन एवं मुख्यालय)** is a core static General Awareness topic for the **UPSSSC PET** exam.
Includes bodies established from **1945 (United Nations)** onwards, as well as regional bodies like **SAARC (1985)** and security alliances like **NATO (1949)**.
Key global hubs include **Geneva (Switzerland)**, **New York (USA)**, **Washington, D.C. (USA)**, **Paris (France)**, and **Vienna (Austria)**.
International civil servants, Secretary-Generals, Directors-General, and member nation representatives.
Fetches **1-2 direct marks** in the General Awareness section regarding headquarters locations, establishment years, and current heads.
Classification into UN specialized agencies, financial institutions, trade bodies, and regional cooperative associations.
High-frequency matching questions and multiple-choice questions testing precise city names and acronym expansions.
India is a founding member of the **United Nations (1945)** and **SAARC (1985)**, making India-specific linkages vital for questions.

items.title: United Nations (UN) System & Core Organs
items.content:
• Established on **24 October 1945** after the signing of the **San Francisco Conference**.
• Headquarters located in **New York, USA**.
• Consists of **6 principal organs**: General Assembly, Security Council, Economic and Social Council, Trusteeship Council, International Court of Justice, and Secretariat.
• **Mnemonic for UN 6 Organs:** **'G-S-E-T-I-S'** -> **G**eneral Assembly, **S**ecurity Council, **E**COSOC, **T**rusteeship, **I**CJ, **S**ecretariat.

items.title: Bretton Woods Twins (World Bank & IMF)
items.content:
• Created at the **1944 Bretton Woods Conference** in New Hampshire, USA.
• **World Bank Group** consists of 5 institutions: IBRD, IDA, IFC, MIGA, and ICSID.
• **International Monetary Fund (IMF)** focuses on global financial stability and exchange rate stability.
• Both headquartered in **Washington, D.C., USA**.
• **Mnemonic for Bretton Woods Twins:** **'W-I-W'** -> **W**ashington DC hosts **I**MF and **W**orld Bank.

items.title: Geneva-based Health, Labour & Trade Giants
items.content:
• **WHO (World Health Organization)** founded on **7 April 1948** (World Health Day).
• **ILO (International Labour Organization)** founded in **1919** (oldest specialized agency).
• **WTO (World Trade Organization)** established on **1 January 1995** (replaced GATT).
• All three are headquartered in **Geneva, Switzerland**.
• **Mnemonic for Geneva Organizations:** **'WHO LIKES TRADE GENEVA?'** -> **WHO**, **I**LO, **WTO** are all in **Geneva**.

items.title: UNESCO & Paris Cultural Hub
items.content:
• **UNESCO** stands for United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization.
• Established on **16 November 1945**.
• Headquarters located in **Paris, France**.
• Focuses on world heritage sites, education, and scientific cooperation.
• **Mnemonic for Paris:** **'UNI-PARIS'** -> **UNESCO** is in **Paris**.

items.title: Regional & Security Organizations (SAARC & NATO)
items.content:
• **SAARC** (South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation) established on **8 December 1985** in Dhaka; Headquarters in **Kathmandu, Nepal**.
• **NATO** (North Atlantic Treaty Organization) established on **4 April 1949** via Washington Treaty; Headquarters in **Brussels, Belgium**.
• **Mnemonic for SAARC Members:** **'MBBS PAIN'** -> **M**aldives, **B**angladesh, **B**hutan, **S**ri Lanka, **P**akistan, **A**fghanistan, **I**ndia, **N**epal.

items.term: Trick 1: The Geneva Rule (Health, Labour, Trade)
items.definition: If an organization name starts with **World** and ends with **Organization** (like **WHO**, **WTO**), or relates to **Labour (**ILO**), it is most likely headquartered in **Geneva, Switzerland**.
Any global organization dealing with **Money**, **Finance**, **Bank**, or **Fund** (**World Bank**, **IMF**) has its headquarters in **Washington, D.C., USA**.
Think of stomach and food: **Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO)** and **World Food Programme (WFP)** are both located in **Rome, Italy** (home of ancient feasts).
Art, culture, education, and science are best represented by **Paris, France** (**UNESCO**).
Remember **SAARC** is strictly for South Asia, headquartered in **Kathmandu, Nepal**, while **ASEAN** is for Southeast Asia, headquartered in **Jakarta, Indonesia**.
The **International Court of Justice (ICJ)** is the only principal UN organ **NOT** located in New York; it sits at **The Hague, Netherlands**.

items.term: Mistake 1: Confusing WHO and FAO Headquarters
items.definition: Students often guess Rome for WHO. Remember **WHO is in Geneva**, while **FAO is in Rome**.

items.term: Mistake 2: Mixing up World Bank and IMF Founding Dates
items.definition: They were agreed upon in **1944** at Bretton Woods, but operationalized in **1945**. Check exam options carefully.
Do not mark New York for the **International Court of Justice (ICJ)**. Its correct seat is **The Hague, Netherlands**.
Do not swap **Kathmandu** (SAARC) with **Jakarta** (ASEAN).

items.term: Mistake 5: WTO vs GATT Establishment Year
items.definition: GATT was formed in **1948**, but **WTO** was officially born on **1 January 1995** after the Marrakesh Agreement.
United Nations Day is **24 October 1945**, not 24 November or December.
The **United Nations (UN)** was established on **24 October 1945** with its headquarters in **New York, USA**.
**World Bank** and **IMF** were created in **1944** and are headquartered in **Washington, D.C.**
**WHO**, **WTO**, and **ILO** are major global bodies headquartered in **Geneva, Switzerland**.
**UNESCO** is headquartered in **Paris, France**, focusing on education and cultural heritage.
**FAO** (Food and Agriculture Organization) has its headquarters in **Rome, Italy**.
**ICJ** is located at the **Peace Palace in The Hague, Netherlands**.
**SAARC** was founded on **8 December 1985** with headquarters in **Kathmandu, Nepal**.
**NATO** was formed in **1949** and is headquartered in **Brussels, Belgium**.
**ASEAN** consists of **10 Southeast Asian nations** with headquarters in **Jakarta, Indonesia**.
Direct matching questions on headquarters carry guaranteed marks in **UPSSSC PET General Awareness**.

upscNotes.content: For UPSSSC PET, always memorize the exact city and country for top 15 global organizations (UN, WHO, UNESCO, IMF, World Bank, WTO, SAARC, NATO, ASEAN, FAO).
Examiners often create confusion between Geneva and Rome for food and health organizations. Remember: Health = Geneva, Food = Rome.
Make flashcards of establishment years for 1944, 1945, 1948, 1985, and 1995 as these are recurring years in UPSSSC exams.
Do not assume all UN bodies are in New York. The ICJ is in The Hague, and several agencies are in Geneva and Vienna.

keyTakeaways: World Bank and IMF are known as Bretton Woods twins, headquartered in Washington, D.C.
WHO, WTO, and ILO are headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland.
UNESCO is headquartered in Paris, France.
SAARC headquarters is located in Kathmandu, Nepal, established in 1985.
ICJ is the only principal UN organ not in New York; it is in The Hague, Netherlands.
FAO headquarters is in Rome, Italy.
